verdict.rationale: AWS documents some first-party background automation. AWS Budgets can automatically apply an IAM policy when a cost threshold is hit, and AgentCore deploys agents to production at scale. The CLI and Lambda also support scripted and serverless execution. But nothing in the evidence shows a general way to set up automations that are triggered or scheduled and then run on their own in the background, and nothing shows recurring schedules as opposed to one-off scripted runs. missing for 10: documented scheduling/recurring triggers (e.g., cron-style or event-driven rules), general-purpose background workflow orchestration, evidence that deployed agents run autonomously unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration
